newsitem.title: USA: Clorox buying Armor All in $400 million deal.
newsitem.headline: Clorox buying Armor All in $400 million deal.

text.p: The Clorox Co. said Tuesday it would buy Armour All Products Corp., a leading maker of automobile cleaning products, in a deal valued at about $400 million.

Clorox said it and Armour All had reached an agreement under which Clorox would buy all of Armour All's stock at a price of $19.09 per share. Armour All stock was unchanged at $17.50 on Nasdaq before being halted for the release of the news.
McKesson Corp., which owns 55 percent of Armour All common stock, has agreed to sell all its shares, Clorox said.
Clorox said it expected to launch its offer Dec. 2 and complete the stock purchase by the end of the year. It said it planned to fund the purchase with cash and short-term borrowing.

Armour All's board of directors has recommended that Armour All shareholders approve Clorox's offer, said Oakland, Calif.-based Clorox, a major maker of household cleaning products. Armour All is based in Aliso Viejo, Calif.
